blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Police officers rescued 15 Chinese nationals in Alicia, Zamboanga Sibugay, Monday afternoon following a tip-off from local officials. Police Capt. Russel Jan Parungao, spokesperson for the Zamboanga Sibugay Police Provincial Office (ZSBPPO), said Alicia Mayor Ardin Musa alerted the Alicia Municipal Police Station (MPS) at around 1:00 p.m. after local authorities spotted the foreign nationals in Barangay Tandiong Muslim. Upon receiving the alert, Alicia MPS personnel immediately deployed to the area, along with officers from the ZSBPPO Provincial Intelligence Unit (PIU) and the 1st Provincial Mobile Force Company (PMFC).
